item.title: Recycle Utah set to move locations after city and county reach land agreement
item.description: After operating out of the old bus barn for 35 years, it’s time for Recycle Utah to say goodbye. The new facility will be bigger and in a more centralized spot for the entire county.

item.title: Woman who lost garage to lithium battery fire receives new furnace through 'Heat for the Holidays'
item.description: A Salt Lake City woman who suffered a garage fire caused by spontaneously combusting lithium-ion batteries has received a new furnace after living without heat for two winters.

item.title: Utah Senate committee advances bill reshaping Salt Lake City transportation decisions
item.description: People packed the Senate Transportation Committee hearing on Monday to share their thoughts on Senate Bill 242, which clarifies how Salt Lake City and UDOT should collaborate on certain streets.
